metaDescription: Free browser based SVG tools. Edit SVG code, fix broken viewBox attributes, validate markup and extract color palettes. No signup, nothing uploaded.
intro:
Why edit SVG code directly

SVG files look simple but small mistakes in the underlying markup can break how an icon renders, bloat a file's size, or cause it to fail validation entirely. Since an SVG is really just XML text, editing it directly with a proper SVG Code Editor often gets you a cleaner result than clicking through a heavy design application, especially when a file behaves unexpectedly after being exported from a tool like Figma or Illustrator.

Common problems this collection solves

The tools here target the issues that come up constantly when working with vector graphics on the web. Use the SVG Viewer & Validator to catch invalid markup before you ship it, the ViewBox Fixer to correct a missing or broken viewBox so an SVG scales correctly at any size, and the Palette Extractor to pull a consistent color palette out of an existing icon or logo.

Privacy first, every time

Every tool in this collection runs entirely in your browser using the File and Canvas APIs built into modern browsers, so nothing you upload is ever sent to a server, stored, or logged anywhere. That makes it a safe option for client work or unreleased branding. Once your SVG is ready, our Developer Utilities pick up where this collection leaves off, turning that same artwork into a CSS ready data URI or a full Tailwind color theme.

intro:
Small tools for everyday frontend work

Most frontend projects need a handful of small utilities that are too minor to justify installing another dependency, but tedious enough to slow you down when handled by hand. Use the SVG to CSS Data URI tool to convert artwork into an inline, CSS ready string without a build step or bundler plugin.

From image to design system

The Image to Tailwind Palette tool turns any image, including a rendered SVG from our SVG & Design Tools collection, into a complete Tailwind color theme with proper shade scales generated automatically, ready to paste into your project's config.

Client side, no signup

More utilities will be added here over time, each one focused on solving a single problem well. Everything runs client side in your browser, so files you work with never leave your device, and there is no account required to use any tool in this collection.

intro:
Why technical SEO gets missed

Technical SEO problems are often invisible until they cost a site real rankings. A missing canonical tag, a broken redirect chain, or a robots.txt file that accidentally blocks search engines from crawling important pages can undo months of content work without any obvious symptom pointing to the cause.

What this collection will cover

Tools here will let you check the technical details search engines actually rely on, directly from your browser, so problems get caught before they affect search performance. This collection is launching alongside our SVG & Design Tools and Developer Utilities, with new SEO checks added as they are built.
